messages:
alex_finance: Quick question from the AH: Sam mentioned a 'spend gateway'—what are the gates and who approves exceptions?
sam_ceo: FYI: we9ve codified a simple traffic-light gate: GREEN = low-impact <$10k (team lead); AMBER = $10k$75k (finance + manager); RED = >$75k (exec + legal). Exceptions handled via the Exceptions queue.
maya_product: For AMBER items, does finance always require an ROI calc or is a short justification ok?
alex_finance: Short justification (2 lines) is fine for AMBER if it9s time-sensitive; otherwise include a 1-slide ROI. Finance will triage within 3 business days.
leo_engineering: What about emergency infra that would degrade customer SLAs if not renewed? Can that jump straight to RED for faster review?
sam_ceo: Emergency SLA-impacting requests get an "URGENT" flag. Tag them and include the customer-impact sentence; we9ll target a 48h turnaround. This bypasses normal queuing but still needs the same approvals.
procure-bot: [automated] Procurement playbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/procure-playbook. Use the "URGENT" checkbox for SLA items.
maya_product: Curious about vendor pre-pay discounts and credits—how aggressively should teams negotiate?
alex_finance: Negotiate where it materially improves unit economics. If pre-pay changes cashflow > $25k, include a burn impact line. Ops/Finance will run a quick calc.
leo_engineering: Also re: payment method—PO vs corporate card? Some vendors only take card.
alex_finance: Prefer PO for traceability. Cards ok for < $5k and for onboarding vendors when PO not supported; capture receipts and link to the procurement request.
sam_ceo: One more: procurement should be looped in early. We have negotiation templates that often secure credits or trial extensions—bring them in before signing.
maya_product: Actionable ask: can finance share a 1-page "what to include" checklist for quick triage?
alex_finance: Will post checklist + a fillable 2-line justification template in the playbook today and ping channels.
sam_ceo: Thanks. Teams: consolidate any open AMBER+ items into a short list for FP&A review by next Thurs. Keep the bar high.
